title: Institutions Drive Bitcoin Surge
script_summary:
**Institutions are locking up Bitcoin supply at scale, and the narrative's shifted—this isn't hype, it's capital repositioning.**

BlackRock and major players are flooding in. ETF flows confirm it. Supply's tightening. Bitcoin holds $76K with hashrate crushing 1,035 exahashes. The network's bulletproof.

Here's what matters: institutions see fiat for what it is—a con. They're treating Bitcoin like the inflation hedge gold never was. AI's rise only accelerates this. Corporate treasuries need sove
